The body said that Diallo had been "invited... to stand as a candidate in the FIFA presidential election in March 2027" and that European national associations had "unanimously pledged their full support".

stories.title: World marathon champion Jepchirchir gets three-year doping ban
stories.summary: Reigning world marathon champion Peres Jepchirchir has been banned for three years for a doping violation. The 33-year-old, who also won Olympic gold in 2021, was provisionally suspended by the Athletics Integrity Unit (AIU) in October after an out-of-competition sample tested positive for erythropoietin (EPO). The sample was collected in Kenya prior to Jepchirchir winning the Sydney Marathon on 30 August 2026 and returned an adverse finding on 17 September.

stories.title: SC to commence final hearing of pleas on marital rape in December
stories.summary: New Delhi, The Supreme Court on Thursday said it would list a batch of petitions pertaining to the contentious issue of marital rape for final hearing in December. The apex court is seized of petitions raising the vexed legal question of whether a husband should enjoy immunity from prosecution for the offence of rape if he forces his wife, who is not a minor, to have sex.

stories.title: Sandpapergate scandal: Pat Cummins will struggle to captain team without refuting Bancroft’s words, says Healy
